⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities

1. Take-Up Maximisation

Identify 1.3M+ unpaid carers not claiming. Community outreach. Simplified application. Proxy claims for elderly. Target 100% take-up.

2. Earnings Flexibility

Modernise earnings threshold. Real-time HMRC integration. Permitted work reform. Self-employment fair treatment. Gig economy compatibility.

3. Digital Inclusion

Telephone-first for carers. Paper forms maintained. Trusted person proxy. Accessible formats. No digital-only barriers.

4. Young Carer Protection

Safeguarding-first approach. Education maintenance. Mental health priority. Transition support at 16. Local authority integration.

5. Carer Wellbeing Integration

NHS carer pathway linking. Respite care auto-referral. Mental health screening. Social isolation detection. Employment support.

6. Overlapping Benefit Clarity

Clear guidance on overlaps. Best-rate auto-recommendation. No gaps in support. Pension-age carer protection. UC transition support.

7. Fraud Without Harassment

Evidence-based risk scoring. No blanket investigations. Proportionate checks. Dignity-first compliance. Carer-friendly processes.

8. Parliamentary Transparency

Real-time carer dashboard. Caseload reporting. Poverty metrics. Policy modelling. Carer strategy evidence.

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No unpaid carer left without support — Carer's Allowance must be accessible to all 6.5M carers in the UK
  • ❌ No earnings threshold applied without real-time HMRC data — prevent overpayments and underpayments
  • ❌ No young carer assessed without safeguarding protocol and education impact review
  • ❌ No caring hours claim rejected without face-to-face or telephone interview option
  • ❌ No overlap penalty without best-rate recommendation — carers must receive the highest qualifying benefit
  • ❌ No fraud investigation of carers without risk-scored evidence threshold and dignity protocol
